import ipaddress, random, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import native, fib
U=1<<128

def gen(rng):
    n=rng.choice([0,1,2,3,10,50,200])
    routes={}
    for _ in range(n):
        length=rng.randint(0,128)
        v=rng.getrandbits(128)
        size=1<<(128-length)
        start=v//size*size
        routes[(start,length)]=rng.randint(0,2147483647)
    return routes

def brute(routes, x):
    best=None; bl=-1
    for (s,l),h in routes.items():
        mask=(U-1)^((1<<(128-l))-1) if l else 0
        if x&mask==s and l>bl: bl=l; best=h
    return best

bad=0
for seed in range(int(sys.argv[1]),int(sys.argv[2])):
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    routes=gen(rng)
    py=fib.runs_of(routes)
    nt=native.atlas(routes)
    if ([list(x) for x in py]!=[list(x) for x in nt]):
        print("seed",seed,"MISMATCH py",py[0][:6],nt[0][:6],len(py[0]),len(nt[0])); bad+=1; continue
    # canonical checks: first start 0, strictly increasing, coalesced, correct LPM
    s,h=py
    assert s[0]==0 and all(a<b for a,b in zip(s,s[1:])), "order"
    assert all(a!=b for a,b in zip(h,h[1:])), "coalesce"
    if s: assert s[0]==0
    for _ in range(20):
        x=rng.getrandbits(128)
        rank=max(i for i,p in enumerate(s) if p<=x)
        if h[rank]!=brute(routes,x): print("seed",seed,"LPM wrong"); bad+=1; break
    # empty RIB
    if not routes:
        assert s==[0] and h==[None], "empty atlas"
print("atlas fuzz failures",bad)
EOF
